_doc: The play actions this world registers. Each becomes a / command; typing it is the player saying its prompt; {args} is replaced by the words after the command. Names use letters, digits and hyphens and must not clash with built-in commands.

actions.prompt: I go up to {args} and speak.

actions.help: Look around and see what is here
actions.prompt: I look around carefully, taking in the people and things here.
